text:
Olivia (CSM): Heads-up: Sunset Lane wants a quick QBR spend sanity check before renewal. They reported surprise embed activity. Need a 90-day forecast (conservative/expected/high), a one-page ops checklist, and an alert rule we can hand them. Can FinOps + Analytics run numbers by EOD? cc @Marcus @Tori
Marcus (FinOps): On it. I'll produce billed-token rows using $0.00048/token and include tokens/day, $/day, $/month and +/- sensitivity bands. Defaulting to billed tokens unless they ask for gross.
Tori (Analytics): Running route-level extraction now. SQL: ```SELECT day, route, SUM(tokens) tokens FROM requests WHERE account='sunset-lane' GROUP BY day, route ORDER BY day DESC LIMIT 120;``` will include p95 and flag scheduled job days.
Diego (AE): Context: they enabled embeddings for search + a nightly full reindex. Onboarding ~71%. Renewal in ~38 days. They want per-route invoice mapping and clearer spend alerts.
alert-bot: [automated] Anomaly: account=sunset-lane 3-day avg tokens rose 2.7x (detected 2026-08-11). Baseline route 'search-embed' p95=50k/day.
Hannah (Enablement): I can run a 30-min "Embed cost triage" session: prefix caching, per-route quotas, SDK batching. Proposed Tue 9am PT. I'll draft a 1-pager with config snippets.
Olivia (CSM): Please include an example guardrail rule and a suggested temporary cap we can offer if they want invoice protection. Also capture their feedback: "per-route billing" and "reindex scheduling guidance".
Marcus (FinOps): Draft guard rule for the playbook: ```if route('search-embed').avg24h > baseline*2.5 then post('#cs-cost') and POST /webhooks/customer-alerts {"acct":"sunset-lane","reason":"spike"}; apply_rate_limit(route='search-embed', pct=60)``` I'll output three rows: conservative (reindex stabilized), expected (current cadence), high (broader adoption) with sensitivity +/-10/25/50%.
Tori (Analytics): Uploaded CSV -> https://files.redwood/sunsetlane-90d-forecast.csv. Notes: median daily tokens=23k; two reindex days >145k; route p95 for search-embed=52k. Added 90-day rolling median + p95 chart.
Diego (AE): I'll ask their infra lead to stagger reindex windows and label non-critical routes so we can throttle them if needed. Also flagging renewal risk: they may request credits if surprise charges persist.
Hannah (Enablement): I'll prepare the checklist: 1) set per-route quota, 2) enable prefix cache, 3) schedule reindex off-peak + incremental option, 4) add webhook alert. Include copy-paste SDK snippets.
Olivia (CSM): Can we meet 4pm PT today to finalize the one-pager and the ask? Goal: one-page with the forecast table + recommended guardrail + enablement invite to send to the customer before the renewal call.
Marcus (FinOps): 16:00 PT works. I'll have the 3-row table and a short note on offering a temporary cap (e.g., 30k/day) and its invoice implications.
Tori (Analytics): I'll join with the CSV and charts.
alert-bot: [system] Next summary scheduled at 15:30 PT with updated token metrics.
Olivia (CSM): Thanks team 680. Want the customer to leave with a predictable bill path and an actionable checklist to avoid surprises.
